newsitem.title: USA: Eagle River to buy French company.
newsitem.headline: Eagle River to buy French company.

text.p: AVON, Colo, Nov 25 - Eagle River Interactive said on Monday it agreed to buy the assets of Groupe SRC, a Paris-based company specializing in multimedia localization for an undisclosed amount of cash.
Eagle River said the purchase, which is expected to be completed within the next four weeks, will provide it with an opportunity to expand in Europe.
Eagle River said it is currently working with Disneyland Paris, for example, to develop a Web site that is localized in six languages, French, English, German, Spanish, Italian and Dutch.
